text: 7月，受高温天气叠加传统淡季因素影响，重点城市房地产成交环比有所走弱，但和去年同期对比整体仍具备韧性，多城新房、二手房成交量同比保持增长，其中上海核心区高端改善盘表现抢眼，豪宅项目再现开盘日光。
text_en: In July, affected by high temperatures and traditional off-season factors, property transactions in key cities weakened month-on-month, but remained resilient compared to the same period last year, with new and second-hand home volumes in many cities growing year-on-year. High-end improved properties in Shanghai's core areas stood out, with luxury projects seeing same-day sellouts on launch.
